decisionsTitle: «Lista de așteptare e publică»: the public list's waiting list is a per-event switch
decisionsSection:
**Amends §396, narrowing it; §421's per-runner rule and §32's gates are unchanged.** The owner, 2026-10-01: "Acum mai am nevoie de încă o setare cu „lista de așteptare e publică”".

**What it is.** A per-event switch, `events.waitlist_public boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false` (migration `0119_waitlist_public.sql`, expand only), shown in the event editor under «Publică lista participanților» as an indented second box, «Lista de așteptare e publică» / “The waiting list is public”, with its note: on the public list also appear those on the waiting list who ticked «Vreau să apar», in the list's order, without a position — only while the privacy notice in force describes the states. It sits inside the same type and mode wrappers as the list's own box, so it exists only where a list can.

**What it changes on the list.** The waiting-list group — the `WAITLISTED` rows, the word «Pe lista de așteptare», its legend sentence, its count in the line above the table, and its clause in the caption and the note — is drawn only when the switch is on, on top of the two existing gates: the notice in force names `{{participantListStates}}` in every language (§396), and the runner ticked under a notice at or after the first one that did (§421). It is a third condition on that one group, never a way round the other two. The pending group («Înscris, în așteptarea confirmării») stays behind the notice's gates alone. It is implemented at the reader, not at the drawing: `listPublicStartListOthers` and `countPublicStartListOthers` take a required `includeWaitlisted`, which leaves `WAITLISTED` out of the SQL's state list when false, and `cachedStartListOthersCounts` / `cachedStartListOthersPage` carry it in their cache keys — so a switched-off event never reads or counts a waiting row, and a page read with the waiting list is never served to one without it. The select list is unchanged (`tests/privacy/public-surface.test.ts`). With the switch off and the notice describing the states, the caption and the note use sentences without the waiting list (`captionStatesNoWaitlist`, `captionStatesNumbersNoWaitlist`, `noteStatesNoWaitlist`).

**What it changes on the form.** The «Vreau să apar» caption (`Registration.listOptInStates`) named «Pe lista de așteptare» as a stage the runner would be shown in. On an event whose waiting list is not public it now reads `listOptInStatesNoWaitlist`: the pending and the confirmed stages only, and that a runner waiting for a place does not appear on the public list — «Cât aștepți un loc pe lista de așteptare, nu apari pe lista publică.», the public list named outright so that «ea» cannot be read as the waiting list itself (`form-view.ts#listOptInStatesKey`, from the view's new `listShowsWaitlist`). The staff entry form's line (`Admin.registrations.listOptInStates`) is left as it was: it speaks before an event is chosen.

**How it is stored.** True only beside `participant_list_visibility = NAMES` on an `INTERNAL` event; anything else stores false whatever was posted (`service.ts#waitlistPublicColumn`, beside the NAMES refusal's own pair), so the column never holds a truth the list cannot act on, and a list switched off and on again does not find the waiting list already public. Beside a published list, a caller that does not post the box writes nothing (the discipline `kitShirt` follows); the editor's checkbox always posts, absent meaning off. A duplicate never inherits it, as it never inherits the list (AGENTS.md §10.10); a series edit carries it with the list.

**The default, and what it does to existing events.** Off — and the owner said it in so many words, 2026-10-01 evening: «nu fac asta până nu punem bifa cu lista de așteptare privată», that is, the waiting list is not shown until the box that keeps it private exists. An event that publishes its list today, under a notice that describes the states, stops showing its waiting list until the club ticks the box — "with the switch off, the list is what it is today minus the waiting-list rows". That is the narrowing direction, chosen because a public waiting list is now a per-event decision.

**The notice is left as an upper bound.** The privacy notice's template still says, in section 4, that the list holds «cei de pe lista de așteptare» (and its English twin). With the switch off by default that sentence describes the most the list can show, not what every event shows — and it is deliberately not re-templated here: a changed template would make the club approve the notice again for a sentence that stays true (the notice promises a maximum, and the switch only ever narrows it). A later template change may add «unde clubul o face publică pentru eveniment» if the club prefers the notice to say it.

**Refused.** A position on the waiting list (still not printed, §396); a per-runner waiting-list consent separate from «Vreau să apar» (the tick and the notice already cover it, §421); the switch opening anything without the notice (it adds a condition, never removes one); a default of on (it would publish without anybody deciding for that event).

**Docs.** AGENTS.md §10.10 and its column list, CLAUDE.md's rules-table row on the public list, the backoffice «Ghid» step on the legal texts and «Sarcini»'s row on the notice's states (`listStatesNotice`: its done line names the switch, and its steps no longer say the stages need "no other setting") name the switch.

**Tests.** `tests/privacy/public-surface.test.ts` (the readers with the switch off: no waiting row, none counted, the pending row kept, the select list unchanged; on: §396's and §421's rows; the public event query carries the column); `tests/integration/registrations/start-list-states.test.ts` (the rendered list with the waiting list private, in both languages; the older notice shows the confirmed alone whichever way the switch is); `tests/integration/cms/participant-list-privacy-guard.test.ts` (stored true only beside NAMES; a hidden list stores false; an omitted box changes nothing; switching the list off switches it off); unit: `startListSummary`'s words, `waitlistPublicColumn`, `formViewOf`/`listOptInStatesKey`, and the register page's caption in both languages. `tests/e2e/public-list-states.spec.ts` seeds its main event with the switch on and a second event with it off (the default): there the pending row is listed and no waiting row, count, legend line or word appears, in both languages, and the form's caption names no waiting-list stage.

Migration: `0119_waitlist_public.sql`.
changelogLine: - **«Lista de așteptare e publică», a switch per event** — under «Publică lista participanților» in the event editor, off by default: the public list shows the waiting list (those who ticked «Vreau să apar», in the list's order, no position) only for an event where it is on, and still only while the privacy notice describes the states; the form's caption under the tick names the waiting-list stage only there. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event whose list is `NAMES`, while the privacy notice in force names `{{participantListStates}}` in every language, the ticked `WAITLISTED` registrations (under §421's notice rule) appear — with «Pe lista de așteptare», their count, their legend sentence and the caption's and the note's clause — only when the event's «Lista de așteptare e publică» (`events.waitlist_public`) is on; off, no waiting row is read or counted, the pending group is unchanged, and with the notice gate off nothing beyond the confirmed is shown whichever way the switch is (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

`events.waitlist_public` is false by default and on every duplicate; the service stores true only beside `participant_list_visibility = NAMES` on an `INTERNAL` event and false otherwise, whatever was posted; beside a published list a caller that does not post it leaves it unchanged (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose list is published and whose «Lista de așteptare e publică» is off, when the registration form renders under a notice that describes the states, then the caption under «Vreau să apar» names only «Înscris, în așteptarea confirmării» and «Confirmat» and says that, while waiting for a place on the waiting list, the runner does not appear on the public list; with the switch on it names «Pe lista de așteptare» too (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a per-event switch «Lista de așteptare e publică» for the public list's waiting list
